description: This file provides the front-end React component and server-side logic for editing a note within a notes management application. It includes data loading, form handling, and API interactions for updating a specific note.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads a specific note based on the noteId parameter for editing purposes.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission to update the note via API and redirects upon success.

methods.name: normalizeTags
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string of tags into an array, trimming whitespace and filtering out empty entries.

calls: makeApiRequest(`/notes/${noteId}`, { method: 'PUT', session, body: { title, content, tags } })
